Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: SAVAGE INLAND MARINE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 34.521012, -88.320207 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 58800 gallon
Report Description**THIS REPORT IS RELATED TO NRC REPORTS 1257565 AND 1257566** THE NATIONAL RESPONSE RECEIVED UPDATED INCIDENT INFORMATION VIA USCG NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER E-MAIL. REPORT IS AS FOLLOWS: A BARGE BEING TOWED BY TUG ALLIDED WITH THE JAMIE L WHITTEN LOCK AND DAM, DAMAGING A CARGO TANK WHICH RESULTED IN THE DISCHARGE OF CRUDE OIL INTO THE TOMBIGBEE WATERWAY. 1400 BARRELS HAVE DISCHARGED AND THE AFFECTED TANK CONTAINS 6700 BARRELS. AT THIS TIME, ONLY MINOR SHEENING WAS OBSERVED OUTSIDE THE LOCK WITH NO REPORTED PRODUCT ESCAPING. THE WATERWAY HAS BEEN CLOSED, AND A SAFETY ZONE HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED FROM MILES 410 TO 414.

Report DescriptionCALLER STATED IS REPORTING THE RELEASE OF 75 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL DUE TO A MOTOR VEHICLE INCIDENT. CALLER STATED THE SPILL CAME FROM THE SADDLE TANKS OF A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK DUE TO A SINGLE VEHICLE ACCIDENT. CALLER STATED THE TANKS WERE RIPPED OFF OF THE TRUCK DUE TO THE ROLLOVER OF THE TRUCK. CALLER STATED THE CAUSE OF THE INCIDENT IS UNKNOWN. CALLER STATED THE SPILL WAS TO ASPHALT AND THERE WAS NOT A SPILL OF THE DIESEL FUEL TO A WATERWAY OR A STORM DRAIN. CALLER STATED THE TRUCK DRIVER WAS INJURED. THE DRIVER WAS ENTRAPPED AND EXTRACTED FROM THE VEHICLE AND TRANSPORTED TO ONE OF THE BIG HOSPITALS IN CORPUS CHRISTI, TEXAS WITH SERIOUS INJURIES. THE ROADWAY (HIGHWAY 77) WAS CLOSED GOING NORTH AND SOUTH FOR TWO HOURS DUE TO THIS INCIDENT. CALLER STATED CURRENTLY SOUTHBOUND TRAFFIC IS STILL SHUTDOWN. NORTHBOUND HWY 77 HAS ONE LANE OPEN. THE RAILROAD BRIDGE BARRIER AT THE SCENE WAS STRUCK BUT THE BRIDGE WAS NOT IMPACTED.

CALLER STATED THE SPILL CAME FROM THE SADDLE TANKS OF A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK DUE TO A SINGLE VEHICLE ACCIDENT. CALLER STATED THE TANKS WERE RIPPED OFF OF THE TRUCK DUE TO THE ROLLOVER OF THE TRUCK. CALLER STATED THE CAUSE OF THE INCIDENT IS UNKNOWN. CALLER STATED THE SPILL WAS TO ASPHALT AND THERE WAS NOT A SPILL OF THE DIESEL FUEL TO A WATERWAY OR A STORM DRAIN. CALLER STATED THE TRUCK DRIVER WAS INJURED. THE DRIVER WAS ENTRAPPED AND EXTRACTED FROM THE VEHICLE AND TRANSPORTED TO ONE OF THE BIG HOSPITALS IN CORPUS CHRISTI, TEXAS WITH SERIOUS INJURIES. THE ROADWAY (HIGHWAY 77) WAS CLOSED GOING NORTH AND SOUTH FOR TWO HOURS DUE TO THIS INCIDENT. CALLER STATED CURRENTLY SOUTHBOUND TRAFFIC IS STILL SHUTDOWN. NORTHBOUND HWY 77 HAS ONE LANE OPEN. THE RAILROAD BRIDGE BARRIER AT THE SCENE WAS STRUCK BUT THE BRIDGE WAS NOT IMPACTED.

Report Description///THIS IS A 48 HOUR UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1320131/// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: INCIDENT CAUSE: CHANGED FROM UNKNOWN TO OTHER REMEDIAL ACTION: RELEASE IS SECURED, INVESTIGATION IS COMPLETE MATERIAL RELEASE: CHANGED FROM POTENTIAL TO ACTUAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: THE HALF INCH PLASTIC SERVICE PIPELINE WAS INSERTED INTO A 1 AN 1 QUARTER INCH STEEL SERVICE PIPELINE. THE HOME OWNER DUG A FIRE PIT AND THE STEEL CASING WAS AT THE BOTTOM OF THE FIRE PIT. THE HOME OWNER HAD A FIRE IN THE FIRE PIT CAUSING THE 1/2 INCH PLASTIC SERVICE LINE TO MELT. THIS CAUSED THE GAS TO TRAVEL IN THE OLD STEEL LINE TO TRAVEL TO THE RESIDENCE. THE HOME OWNER SMELLED GAS THE NIGHT BEFORE AND THE DAY OF AND DID NOT CALL THE OPERATOR. THE MORNING OF THE EXPLOSION THE HOME OWNER TRIED TO LIGHT A CIGARETTE CAUSING THE EXPLOSION. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: CALLER STATES THERE WAS A FIRE AND EXPLOSION AT A RESIDENTIAL HOME. THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR NATURAL GAS TO RELEASE FROM A DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE TO THE ATMOSPHERE. CALLER STATES THERE 4 INJURIES SENT TO THE HOSPITAL BUT NO FATALITIES. WEST MICHIGAN STREET WAS CLOSED E/W. THAT WAS ALL THE INFORMATION THE CALLER PROVIDED.

Nearest City: Solon, OH
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: AMMONIA, ANHYDROUS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: NESTLE
Skytruth Analysis
APPROXIMATELY 140 POUNDS OF AMMONIA WAS RELEASED FROM AN AMERIO FREEZER INSIDE NESTLE PLANT AT 5750 HARPER ROAD SOLON OHIO. THERE WERE NO INJURIES. THE PPM OUTSIDE OF THE FREEZER CABINET REACHED 175 PPM AND DISSIPATED IN A 100 FT. RADIUS WITHIN THE PLANT TO 15 PPM. EMPLOYEES ON THE NORTH HALF OF THE FACILITY WERE EVACUATED TO THE CAFETERIA INSIDE THE BUILDING FOR PRECAUTION. PRODUCTION CONTINUED ON THE SOUTH HALF OF PLANT. THE MAJORITY OF THE AMMONIA WAS ISOLATED TO THE AMERIO CABINET AND EXHAUSTED OR PUMPED OUT THROUGH THE PUMP OUT LINE. THE APPROPRIATE REGULATORY COMMISSIONS WERE CONTACTED AS A PRECAUTION BY FACILITY SAFETY MANAGER. THE SAFETY SYSTEMS ON THE FREEZERS WORKED AS DESIGNED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 1070938 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: BARBERS CHEMICALS INC
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1070938
Incident Time: 2008-01-01 12:00:00
Nearest City: Sharpsville, PA
Location: 950 WEST MAIN STREET
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE (15% OR LESS
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: BARBERS CHEMICALS INC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.260800, -80.487609 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 4630 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ABOUT 5 YEARS AGO, AN EMPLOYEE OF BARBER"S CHEMICALS, INC., WAS FILLING SMALL BULK CONTAINERS WITH LIQUID CHLORINE (OR SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE). IN SOME TYPE OF DISTRACTION, HE OPENED THE VALVE ON THE END OF A 2" HOSE TO FILL THE NEXT CONTAINER AND THEN PROMPTLY LEFT FOR LUNCH. THE CHEMICAL TANK FROM WHICH THIS SMALL BULK CONTAINER WAS BEING FILLED HOLDS AS MUCH AS 5,000 GALLONS OF THIS CLASS 8 CORROSIVE OXIDIZER. WHEN HE RETURNED FROM LUNCH, HE FOUND THAT THE ENTIRE 5,000 GALLON CHEMICAL TANK HAD EMPTIED ONTO THE GROUND. THE INCIDENT WAS REPORTED TO HIS BOSS, OWNER OF BARBER"S CHEMICALS, HOWEVER, HE CHOSE NOT TO REPORT THIS INCIDENT TO ANY PROPER AUTHORITIES - AND THE THREAT OF THE LOSS OF EMPLOYMENT IS LIKELY WHAT HAD KEPT HIS EMPLOYEES QUIET UP UNTIL NOW. AFTER SEEING THE PROBLEM IN WEST VIRGINIA, IT SPARKED NOT ONLY MY MEMORY BUT MY EMPATHY FOR PRIVATE CITIZENS. MAYBE WORSE, THIS CHEMICAL PLANT WAS BUILT ON TOP OF A KNOWN WASTE DUMP. THE AREA THAT THESE SMALL BULK TANKS ARE FILLED IN USED TO BE A WAREHOUSE FOR TRUCKS. NOT LONG AFTER IT WAS BUILT, IT CRUMBLED UNDER THE WEIGHT OF ITS FOUNDATION, BUILT ON TOP OF GARBAGE AND WASTE MATERIALS WHICH MAY HAVE INCLUDED REFRIGERATORS (A KNOWN SOURCE OF FREON) AND OTHER POTENTIALLY HARMFUL SUBSTANCES, THAT, WHEN COMBINED WITH CHLORINE, FORM POWERFULLY DANGEROUS AND CARCINOGENIC COMPOUNDS. THESE COMPOUNDS CAN THEN BE LEACHED INTO GROUNDWATER AND CONSUMED BY HUMANS THROUGH THE USE OF AREA WELLS. FURTHER, THE MAJORITY OF THE SURROUNDING AREA IS SERVED BY A WATER COMPANY THAT IS JUST DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS CHEMICAL PLANT. THE RIVER THAT FLOWS JUST BEHIND THE CHEMICAL COMPANY, THE SHENANGO RIVER, MAY HAVE BEEN CONTAMINATED WITH ANY NUMBER OF DANGEROUS COMPOUNDS.
